base_decision.if_exact_improvement_gt_0p005: freeze the exact best point as a new recenter target before any further stencil
base_decision.if_recenter_clear_and_PD: run the independently preregistered half-scale Hessian at exactly the same center
base_decision.if_recenter_clear_and_nonPD: freeze exact negative/soft eigenmode rays before any smaller-scale fallback

half_decision.if_recenter_clear_and_PD: require independent fresh-tree replay at this exact center before A5 paired refreeze
half_decision.otherwise: follow the same frozen recenter/ray logic; do not average scales

guard: Local stationarity around the exact half-stencil recenter point only. No global minimum, sigma/Wilks, posterior, AIC/BIC or Bayes claim.
